meta.name: Alkahest Vitriol Tonic
meta.description: Brewed by the subterranean hydro-alchemists of the Abyssal Hydro-Works, who treat the 14x31 quarry as a terraced chemical alembic. Sold by the Pewter Quill Newt to those supplying quill ore, this caustic, umber-tinted brine is meant for mechanisms rather than men. Flooding the gears softens impact and drastically reduces the wear on tools.
meta.author: core:ground_zero
